answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one crystal weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The falcon report shows the merge explicitly at each knoll. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
